settings.mcpHint: Enabled servers are passed to every new or restored ACP session. This first-party manager stores only commands, arguments and URLs; credentials stay with the server or harness instead of being written to Glyphra settings.
settings.keybindingsHint: Shortcuts are stored with the rest of Glyphra settings and synchronize across all open windows.
settings.whenHint: When clauses support editorFocus, projectOpen, settingsOpen, agentBusy, !, && and ||.
settings.keybindingConflict: This shortcut and when clause conflict with another binding.
settings.mcpArgsHint: JSON string array. Environment variables and secret headers are intentionally not persisted.
settings.mcpArgsInvalid: Arguments must be a valid JSON array of strings.
settings.mcpEnabledHint: Changes apply when the next session starts or an archive is restored.
settings.openAgentOnProject: Open Agent when opening a project
settings.openAgentOnProjectHint: Off by default — use the titlebar Agent button to open the right sidebar.
settings.providersHint: API keys stay in the OS keyring. Subscription kinds use CLI login instead of a stored key. Custom endpoints must support the OpenAI Responses API.
settings.subscriptionHint: No API key stored here — the agent CLI uses your existing login/subscription.
settings.secretRequired: Enter an API key before saving this provider type.
settings.openRouterNeedKey: OpenRouter preset filled — paste your API key, then Save.
settings.editorHint: Applies to the center editor. Stored on this machine.
settings.trimTrailingWhitespaceHint: Removes spaces and tabs at line endings.
settings.insertFinalNewlineHint: Ensures non-empty text files end with their existing line ending.
settings.formatOnSaveHint: Lightweight formatter for valid JSON; other languages still use save cleanup.
settings.minimapHint: Shows a compact document overview and viewport marker.
settings.ghostTextHint: Suggests the next few lines as you pause typing. Each suggestion costs one agent turn, so it stays off unless you enable it.
settings.languageServerHint: Completion, hover, go to definition, references, rename and diagnostics. A server starts only after you open a matching file.
settings.languageServerInstallHint: Glyphra does not bundle language servers. Install the executable and make sure it is on PATH, then reopen the file.
settings.terminalWebglHint: Uses GPU rendering when supported and falls back automatically after a context loss.
settings.agentHint: Defaults for new Agent sessions. Change them anytime in the Agent panel.
settings.defaultModeHint: Safe is read-oriented; Unleashed skips edit approvals.
settings.defaultProviderHint: Optional. Leave empty to use CLI login / fixture defaults.
settings.defaultAgentModelHint: Optional harness model identifier used for new sessions.
settings.defaultContextWindowHint: Optional token capacity hint from 1,024 to 4,000,000.
settings.defaultFastModeHint: Requests the harness fast-mode capability when it is available.
settings.aboutHint: Glyphra is in early access and never bundles agent CLIs.
settings.onboardingHint: Re-run the first-run detector for Node, Git, and agent CLIs.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Logs and panic reports stay on this device. A support bundle is created only after you confirm and contains bounded runtime logs plus app/OS metadata—never editor buffers or API keys.
settings.diagnosticBundleConfirm: Create an opt-in support bundle from Glyphra runtime logs and app/OS metadata? Project files, editor buffers, and stored credentials are excluded.
settings.faultDrillsHint: Debug builds only. These controls intentionally exercise crash and recovery paths.
settings.faultRustConfirm: Trigger an intentional Rust panic? The debug backend may stop.
settings.faultRecoveryConfirm: Persist dirty buffers and reload this window to exercise hot-exit restore?
settings.faultRecoveryNeedsDirty: Open a project and edit a file without saving first.
settings.faultRecoveryFailed: The recovery snapshot could not be persisted.
